signals.text: Revenue grew 6% a year over 3 years vs 18% over 5: growth is slowing.
Profit compounded at 9% vs revenue at 6%: operating leverage is showing.
Operating margin expanded 72 bps in 3 years (16.2% → 17.0%).
Over 5 years, operating cash flow was 190% of reported profit: profits are turning into cash.

flags.text: Revenue grew 6% a year over 3 years vs 18% over 5: growth is slowing.

guidance.statement: First half FY27 performance tracks annualized EBITDA well over Rs.80,000 Crores for O2C.
guidance.quote: when you look at the first half of FY 2027 performance, it is in our minds tracking annualized EBITDA well over Rs.80,000 Crores

guidance.statement: New energy earnings contribution will definitely start in FY 2028.
guidance.quote: earnings contribution definitely starting in FY 2028.

guidance.statement: Visibility of high teen growth for Jio business.
guidance.quote: we see visibility of high teen growth for Jio

guidance.statement: Retail online investments are expected to be accretive to the bottom line next year.
guidance.quote: start giving us results next year where they will start being accretive to the bottom line as well.

guidance.statement: Achieving up to 20 gigawatt solar module capacity early next year.
guidance.quote: we will be achieving up to 20 gigawatt early next year.

guidance.statement: Achieving 20-gigawatt solar cell capacity sometime first half next year.
guidance.quote: we will be achieving again 20-gigawatt capacity sometime first half next year.

guidance.statement: Commissioning BESS facility up to 40-gigawatt hour in the next half year.
guidance.quote: In next half year we will commission our BESS facility, which is a pack and container up to 40-gigawatt hour

guidance.statement: Battery cell will come sometime late next year around 35-gigawatt to 40-gigawatt hour.
guidance.quote: cell will come sometime I would say late next year, which is again around 35-gigawatt to 40-gigawatt hour.

delivered.statement: Consol EBITDA reached Rs.62,409 Crores, up 24% year-on-year, and PAT closed at nearly Rs.30,000 Crores, up 34%.
Jio total subscriber base reached 542 million with 300 million 5G customers and 30 million fixed homes.
Reliance Retail revenue grew 6.4% year-on-year to Rs.6,120 crores EBITDA level with an EBITDA margin of 7.8%.
FMCG business delivered revenue of Rs.8,266 Crores in Q2, which is 1.6 times year-on-year growth.
JioHotstar exited the quarter with a total MAU of 440 million, up 10% year-on-year.
O2C EBITDA surged 69% year-on-year to Rs.25,203 Crores.

calls.tone: Confident on structural energy demand and digital scaling, cautious on retail margins and macro turbulence.

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned the timeline for normalization of the 5 million disrupted barrels of refining capacity in the Middle East and Russia.
Pressured on the timeframe and sustainability of retail margin weakness amid intense quick commerce competition.
Inquired about upcoming major capital allocations including data center builds and the upcoming IPL media rights renewal.
Challenged whether Reliance Retail's 42% online grocery growth is underwhelming compared to pure-play quick commerce competitors.

business.summary: Reliance Industries operates across Oil-to-Chemicals (O2C), digital services (Jio Platforms), organized retail (Reliance Retail), FMCG, media (JioStar), and new energy, generating revenues through energy refining, petrochemical production, telecom subscriptions, digital services, and retail commerce.

segments.name: Digital Services (Jio Platforms)
segments.note: Mobility, homes, enterprise, and digital add-ons

segments.name: Retail
segments.note: Grocery, consumer electronics, fashion, and digital commerce

guidance.statement: Management aims to double retail absolute EBITDA over the next two years.
guidance.quote: what we believe is with the scale that will come in this year, the benefit of that scale will convert into value in terms of margins and cash generation over the next two years.

guidance.statement: Achieve solar PV manufacturing integration up to 20-gigawatt annual capacity this year.
guidance.quote: And we are on track, and I have got a few pictures to also demonstrate that, to achieve 20-gigawatt annual capacity for our solar PV manufacturing in an integrated fashion.

guidance.statement: Achieve 40-gigawatt hour battery manufacturing capacity this year, scaling up to 120-gigawatt hour.
guidance.quote: Our battery manufacturing is also progressing well. We will achieve 40-gigawatt hour capacity this year and we have announced the scale-up through our AGM up to 120-gigawatt hour capacity

guidance.statement: FMCG business targets to reach Rs 1 lakh Crores by FY2030.
guidance.quote: and we have anyway announced the target is to kind of take this to Rs.1 lakh Crores on FY2030.

guidance.statement: Start installation of Kutch renewable ecosystem after the monsoons this year.
guidance.quote: We expect to start installation after the monsoons in Kutch. And as the transmission network gets ready, we will start supplying power from Kutch this year.

delivered.statement: Total group revenue grew 25% year-on-year to more than Rs.54,000 Crores EBITDA.
Net profit came in close to Rs.23,200 Crores, up 6% year-on-year.
Jio total customer base reached 533 million with 285 million on the 5G network.
Retail revenue grew 12% year-on-year (11.6% adjusted) to reach Rs.90,000 Crores.
FMCG revenue doubled year-on-year to reach Rs.8,600 Crores.
JioStar operating revenue increased 14% year-on-year to Rs.10,946 Crores.

calls.tone: Cautious on macroeconomic and supply chain volatility, but confident in strategic execution and core consumer momentum.

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned why underlying ARPU growth was weak despite fixed broadband mix improvement and data increases.
Pressed on the duration of dark store investments and specific quantitative targets for quick commerce profitability.
Asked about the shift in stance towards LEO satellites and expected capital expenditure over the next decade.
Repeatedly pressed for quantified unit economics, operating costs, and margins in refining and petrochemicals.

guidance.statement: The commissioning of various factories, both solar and battery again are progressing at good pace.
guidance.quote: The commissioning of various factories, both solar and battery again are progressing at good pace.

guidance.statement: Exemption from customs duty on key petrochemical products is likely to get revoked in the second quarter.
guidance.quote: Exemption from customs duty on key petrochemical products... is likely to get revoked in the second quarter hopefully.

delivered.statement: RIL full year revenue up 10% on revenue.
RIL full year EBITDA up 13.5%.
Jio Platforms annual revenue reached Rs. 1,46,085 Crores, up 14.6% year-on-year.
Retail business achieved highest ever quarterly revenues of Rs. 98,000 Crores in Q4.
FMCG business closed revenue of Rs. 22,000 Crores in 2026.
Jio ended the year with 524 million subscribers, adding 36.3 million net subscribers.

calls.tone: Cautious on macroeconomic energy shocks and supply chain disruptions, but confident in domestic consumption and core business growth.

pushback.gist: Analysts questioned whether using alternate crudes with different chemical compositions would negatively impact distillate yields.
Analysts asked if continued significant operational losses in fuel retailing would necessitate domestic price increases.
Analysts pressed on how Reliance plans to navigate heavy horizontal and quick commerce competition and margin dilution.
Analysts asked if the previously stated timeline for the Jio IPO in the first half of 2026 still holds.

guidance.statement: The company expects to commission its first fully integrated 10-gigawatt peak annual solar manufacturing gigafactory.
guidance.quote: We are well on our track to commission our first fully integrated 10-gigawatt peak annual solar manufacturing gigafactory and we have already announced that we are scaling this up to 20-gigawatt peak.

guidance.statement: The company plans to commission its ingot and wafer facilities at giga scale during the current year.
guidance.quote: During the current year, we will again commission these facilities, fully ramped up to the capacity of 10-gigawatt peak and further expanding it as we progress on 20-gigawatt peak and on capacity.

guidance.statement: The company plans to commission its polysilicon and glass facilities during the current year.
guidance.quote: During the current year, we will again commission these facilities, fully ramped up to the capacity of 10-gigawatt peak and further expanding it as we progress on 20-gigawatt peak and on capacity.

guidance.statement: The company expects to start commissioning its 40-gigawatt-hour battery cell and pack factories in a phased manner during the year.
guidance.quote: And during the year, we will start commissioning these factories.

guidance.statement: The company's new energy power generation capacity will start coming up during the next 12 to 15 months.
guidance.quote: Yes, during next 12 to 15 months our generation capacity will also start coming up.

guidance.statement: The Jio IPO process is imminent and expected to happen in the next few months.
guidance.quote: but it is imminent now, so we are just awaiting the final notification, so it should happen in the next few months for sure.

guidance.statement: FMCG business will more than double its beverage capacity this year with high-speed lines across 12 states.
guidance.quote: We will be more than doubling our capacity on beverages this year. We have high-speed lines across 12 states during the year.

delivered.statement: Consolidated revenue grew by 10% year-on-year for the quarter.
Consolidated EBITDA increased by about 6% year-on-year, while PAT reached 22,290 crores.
Jio added 8.9 million net subscribers during the quarter, taking total subscribers to over 515 million.
Retail business reported highest-ever quarterly revenue of 97,600 crores, up 8.1% year-on-year.
FMCG business reached over 5,000 crores of quarterly turnover, up 60% year-on-year.
Quick commerce run rate reached 1.6 million orders in December.

calls.tone: Confident on consumer and new energy scaling, cautious on near-term retail growth volatility and petrochemical headwinds.

pushback.gist: Analysts pressed on why retail revenue growth slowed down during the quarter and the impact of the RCPL demerger.
Analysts questioned the contribution margin and cash burn profile of the quick commerce business amid heavy discounting.
Analysts raised concerns regarding whether manufacturing ingots and wafers domestically would remain competitive against cheap Chinese imports.
Analysts queried the low sequential ARPU growth of 1% and potential timelines for future tariff hikes.

guidance.statement: Reliance remains on track for the solar PV facility to scale to 10 GWp per annum, with expansion to 20 GWp planned.
guidance.quote: RIL remains on track for the facility to scale to 10 GWp per annum, with expansion to 20 GWp planned, targeting 26% module efficiency

guidance.statement: The BESS giga-factory will operationalise 40 GWh of annual capacity, with a roadmap to 100 GWh.
guidance.quote: RIL will be operationalising 40 GWh of annual capacity, with a roadmap to 100 GWh.

guidance.statement: Reliance targets to build 3 MMTPA of green hydrogen equivalent capacity by 2032 for global markets.
guidance.quote: The business is working towards building 3 MMTPA of green hydrogen equivalent capacity by 2032 for global markets.

guidance.statement: CBG production is on track to reach 1,100 TPD with 55 operating plants by end of FY 2026-27.
guidance.quote: CBG Production has reached 270+ TPD, with 35 operating plants (capacity ~700 TPD), and is on track to reach 1,100 TPD with 55 operating plants by end of FY 2026-27.

guidance.statement: Over the next five years, RIL targets to establish integrated CBG hubs to achieve 1 million tonnes annual CBG capacity.
guidance.quote: Over the next five years, RIL targets to establish integrated CBG hubs to achieve 1 million tonnes annual CBG capacity.

guidance.statement: RCPL revenues are expected to grow multifold by 2030, while aspiring to emerge as a leading global consumer company.
guidance.quote: RCPL will continue its accelerated growth trajectory, with revenues expected to grow multifold by 2030, while aspiring to emerge as one of the leading global branded consumer products companies.

guidance.statement: Reliance has committed to establishing and enabling 100 GW of renewable energy capacity by 2030.
guidance.quote: Establishing and enabling 100 GW of renewable energy capacity by 2030

delivered.statement: Reliance Retail recorded Gross Revenue of Rs 3,71,085 crore, reflecting a growth of 12.1% over previous year.
Reliance Retail EBITDA stood at Rs 27,034 crore with an EBITDA margin of 8.2%.
RCPL's gross revenue doubled in the last one year to Rs 22,000 crore.
Media and Entertainment Revenue from Operations reached Rs 34,917 crore in FY 2025-26.
Media and Entertainment EBITDA stood at Rs 5,842 crore with an EBITDA margin of 16.7%.
Oil and Gas business achieved average production of 26.7 MMSCMD, about 30% of domestic output.

calls.tone: Confident and growth-oriented, highlighting strong execution, strategic expansions in new energy, and resilient consumer businesses.

business.summary: Reliance Industries Limited is a diversified Indian conglomerate operating across retail, consumer products, digital services, media and entertainment, oil and gas exploration, refining, petrochemicals, and emerging clean energy sectors.
